items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I was really disgusted to discover that he had left with Duke Ellington's band. Now, I'm the leader of the band and I don't even know what was going on.

ctx.x: I didn't see him. They had a meeting of the musicians and I didn't know about it. All I did was take care of the music and play. So I waited for him. We had a couple more days to go. We didn't have no trumpet player. I was really disgusted to discover that he had left with Duke Ellington's band. Now, I'm the leader of the band and I don't even know what was going on. So later on when I heard from him I discovered that the boys got in great arguments and whatnot when he wasn't home with me. He was trying to break…
